findings.evidence: Lines 80–83 quantify an open neighborhood `U` of zero in `M`, but conclude “lie in `M`” and then name `A⟨T₁, …, Tₖ⟩`.
findings.fix: Say the coefficients lie in `U`, and describe the resulting object as `M⟨T₁, …, Tₖ⟩` (specializing to `A⟨T₁, …, Tₖ⟩` for ring coefficients).
findings.issue: The `IsRestricted` docstring says coefficients eventually “lie in `M`,” which is vacuous; it also calls the generic module-coefficient condition the defining property of `A⟨T⟩`.

findings.evidence: The module’s main-definition list includes the new submodule at lines 23–25, while lines 29–35 blanket-attribute the module’s definitions and statements to AINTLIB; the PR description states both new declarations were not ported.
findings.fix: Scope the AINTLIB attribution to the pre-existing ring material and explicitly identify these module-coefficient declarations as original to this file/PR.
findings.issue: The module provenance claims “the definitions [and] statements are all” AINTLIB’s work, incorrectly covering the newly added `restrictedMvPowerSeriesSubmodule` and `isRestricted_iff_apply`.

summary: Two docstrings are inaccurate: the generalized predicate description has a neighborhood typo, and the provenance falsely attributes the new declarations to AINTLIB.
